Apr 2026 • Friends
Kinda bad experience with the omakase. I had numerous omakase Wagyu worldwide. But the price is paid and the quality of the experience is unmatched. Wouldn’t describe more. Try it for yourself. Then you will know ;)
Written April 2, 2026
Yazawa Hanoi
Dear Mr. Sean

Thank you very much for visiting us and for taking the time to share your feedback.

We sincerely regret that we were unable to meet your expectations.
Our restaurant operates based on the standards set by our Tokyo headquarters and is expanding across multiple countries, where we have received high evaluations from guests of many different nationalities.

That said, we take your feedback seriously and will continue striving to further improve both the quality of our offerings and the overall experience. We remain committed to consistently delivering the highest standards in both our Wagyu and our service.

We look forward to welcoming you again in the future.
